BEA replaces the files at every release, so a later run of the fetch script gives revised numbers. The statistical discrepancy is GDP less GDI. Sector net lending (Table 5.1) starts in 1960 for the private and government sectors; net lending of the nation (W162RC) is the sum of the two, and the rest of the world's net lending to the United States is its negative. In Table 5.1, gross saving plus the statistical discrepancy equals gross domestic investment plus capital account transactions (net) plus net lending. The implicit price deflator used in the chapter is gdp / gdp_real_2017.
